summary.text: Brian Corriea is the Libertarian Party nominee for South Carolina's 3rd District. According to his campaign website, he is a Navy veteran, husband and father from Williamston, SC, running a self-funded campaign that accepts no donations.

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign website, Corriea served nine years in the U.S. Navy. He describes himself as a libertarian and as a husband and father who lives in Williamston, South Carolina.
He advanced from the Libertarian Party convention on April 11, 2026; his campaign website says the campaign is entirely self-funded and refuses all donations.
